newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinians and Israelis await new U.S. initiative to break the deadlock in Middle East peace process.
- Egyptian President Mubarak tells Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu he is playing with fire.
- Yemen: Representatives of 65 countries and organisations are to study ways of supporting its five-year plan.
- Shareholders of Saudi Cairo Bank may discuss merger with United Saudi Commercial Bank at a meeting to be held on Monday.
- A five-point Gulf Arab state proposal to confront Israel's move to build a new settlement and to salvage the Middle East peace process to be discussed by Arab foreign ministers in Cairo on Sunday.
- Bahrain jails another 22 people. They were among of 59 people accused of an attempt to topple the government.
- Gulf Arab states to discuss in Riyadh on Sunday steps to control the opening of branches of national banks in their states.
